sentences.text: % 15.07.2024 CRL.M.A. 20311/2024 (Exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. The present petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C has been filed by the Petitioners in FIR No.28/2021, registered at Police Station Welcome, Delhi for offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 on the ground that the parties have entered into an amicable settlement.
2. It is stated that the Respondent No.2/complainant is not available today.

3. List on 31.07.2024.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J JULY 15, 2024 S. Zakir
